Resolves #991

Extracts `Neo.calendar.view.month.Component#updateHeaderHeight(scrollTo=false)` to re-measure the rendered `.neo-days-header` height in pixels (`me.headerHeight = data[1].height`) and optionally scroll the month container (`scrollTo=true` on mount and `currentDate` changes), and wires `Neo.calendar.view.MainContainer#afterSetBaseFontSize` to invoke `me.monthComponent.updateHeaderHeight()` when `me.monthComponent?.mounted` is `true` so `onWheel` pixel-math stays accurate after base font size updates.

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR body + unit suite ran` (`change-class: restoration -> fix`).

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/calendar/MonthView.spec.mjs` verifying `updateHeaderHeight` measurement, conditional scrolling, and `MainContainer#afterSetBaseFontSize` propagation) → L2 required (unit verification of `MonthComponent#headerHeight` refresh on `baseFontSize` change).
